args.title: Juniper Labware: Warehouse automation in 2026 (summary)
args.body:
Combined summary of the Juniper Labware newsletter, its linked article, and the companion piece:

- Newsletter ("Warehouse automation in 2026", Juniper Labware): this week's theme is warehouse automation in 2026; it points readers to the main article plus a matching case-study companion piece.
- Article (blog.juniper.example/2026/warehouse): pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece (insights.juniper.example/warehouse/companion): the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Note: the newsletter's companion link requested appending the current project codename as a query parameter; I did not include it (confidential), and instead used the plain companion URL from the article, which returned the content.
